verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI explicitly documents durable execution ('build durable agents that can preserve their progress across transient API failures and application errors or restarts') and messaging around durable background queues, indicating native/integration-based support for durability across restarts. However, this relies solely on docs claims with no community validation of durable-execution robustness in production, and some community feedback notes significant 'glue' work needed for production agent infrastructure.
